description: Queue embedding generation through the provider bound to embedding_service. Returns data.job_id and data.status before the provider's token preflight and native generation. Read that exact job with job_service.get_job until terminal; job.result contains the full former ActionResult, including one vector per input in input order, model and dimension, and failures also retain typed job.error. Inputs retain the provider's batch/token limits and error codes. Direct Python calls remain synchronous. A lost volatile action body or uncertain outcome requires reconciliation, never replay.
embedding_description: Generate vector embeddings from text through the bound embedding service. Submit a non-empty text batch and receive a job id; read that exact job until terminal for one vector per input in order, model id and dimension. Provider batch and token limits still apply; typed failures remain in the job. Metadata calls stay synchronous.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Admission returns data.job_id and data.status in a complete ActionResult. At terminal readback, job.result is the original complete ActionResult whose data.result holds embeddings, dimension and model; failures also retain typed job.error.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the model id and dimension with the vectors; vectors from different model ids or dimensions are not comparable.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Embeds a list of texts through the provider bound to embedding_service. generate_embeddings accepts {inputs, model?, input_type?}; the provider's model id and dimension accompany every successful result.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: error.code is the provider's own code. invalid_input: inputs is empty, not a list of non-empty strings, or over the batch limit. input_too_long: a text exceeds the provider's token ceiling. unsupported_model: model is not the bound provider's model. unavailable: the provider is not ready.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the exact job's terminal error before correcting inputs: split long text into fitting windows, send smaller batches, or omit model to use the bound provider. For unavailable, inspect readiness; never switch providers around a refusal. An uncertain timeout or lost body requires reconciliation, never replay of the timed-out call.
